config.title: Berlin Food Week 2026 - FAQ
config.subtitle: What is public, what needs a booking and how to keep the day realistic.

items.a: Berlin Food Week runs from 5 to 11 October 2026.

items.q: What is House of Food at Berlin Food Week?
items.a: House of Food is a listed public market at BIKINI BERLIN on 9 and 10 October, from 10:00 to 20:00. The organiser lists free entry and describes food products, tasting, shopping and producers on site. Free entry identifies a public anchor, so check the current official page for any entry condition tied to a particular activity.

items.q: Is every Berlin Food Week event open to the public?
items.a: No. Read each listing's access conditions. Events may have free entry, require a reservation, be ticketed, be invitation-only or need a fresh detail check.

items.q: Can I attend Berlin Food Night?
items.a: The official listing describes Berlin Food Night on 5 October as an invitation-only strategy dialogue at AchtBerlin. Do not plan it as a general visitor event without the required invitation.

items.q: Where should I plan the rest of a House of Food day?
items.a: Keep it in City West. BIKINI BERLIN fits naturally with Breitscheidplatz, Kurfürstendamm and the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, then a nearby dinner.
